  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4fde77a5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Get_hydrophobicity)=\n",
    "# Get hydrophobicity\n",
    "\n",
    "*Evaluating amino acid hydrophobicity scores from standard biochemical scales.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.physchem.get_hydrophobicity` assigns hydrophobicity indices per residue using 15 published experimental and statistical scales:\n",
    "- `'eisenberg'`: Consensus normalized scale from Eisenberg et al. (1984).\n",
    "- `'kyte'`: Hydropathy index from Kyte & Doolittle (1982).\n",
    "- `'chothia'`: Transfer free energy scale from Chothia (1976).\n",
    "- `'black'`: Hydrophobicity scale from Black & Mould (1991).\n",
    "- `'wolfenden'`: Free energy of vapor-to-water transfer from Wolfenden et al. (1979).\n",
    "- `'rao'`: Rao & Argos (1986).\n",
    "- `'sweet'`: Sweet & Eisenberg (1983).\n",
    "- `'abraham'`: Abraham & Leo (1987).\n",
    "- `'bull'`: Bull & Breese (1974).\n",
    "- `'guy'`: Guy (1985).\n",
    "- `'miyazawa'`: Miyazawa & Jernigan (1985).\n",
    "- `'roseman'`: Roseman (1988).\n",
    "- `'hopp'`: Hopp & Woods (1981).\n",
    "- `'manavalan'`: Manavalan & Ponnuswamy (1978).\n",
    "- `'fauchere'`: Fauchère & Pliška (1983).\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects of this function: {func}`molsysmt.physchem.get_hydrophobicity`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bf1f0b42",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "By default (`definition='eisenberg'`), the consensus hydrophobicity values are returned for each residue:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "c5854af8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:03.696472Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:03.696200Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.047262Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.039830Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "2425110e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.050167Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:05.049609Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:11.374478Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:11.373451Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a17acbcf",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Demo Systems Catalog\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses demonstration datasets provided by MolSysMT. To explore the full catalog of bundled systems, forms, and file paths, visit the {ref}`Demo Systems <user-foundations-entrance-demo-systems>` guide.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fd9d369e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We query the Eisenberg hydrophobicity scores and plot the sequence profile:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "e74f4842",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:11.381726Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:11.380894Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:11.916242Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:11.915043Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x350 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "hp = msm.physchem.get_hydrophobicity(molsys, element='group', definition='eisenberg')\n",
    "group_names = msm.get(molsys, element='group', name=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))\n",
    "colors = ['crimson' if val > 0 else 'royalblue' for val in hp]\n",
    "ax.bar(range(len(hp)), hp, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)\n",
    "ax.axhline(0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(range(len(hp)))\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(group_names, rotation=45, fontsize=8)\n",
    "ax.set_title('Residue Hydrophobicity Profile (Eisenberg Scale)')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Residue')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Hydrophobicity Index')\n",
    "ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4, axis='y')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "df358137",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

    "\n",

   ]
  },
